title: Momentum crashes after bear markets
description: Does the long-short momentum factor's market beta flip after bear markets (Daniel-Moskowitz)?
question: macro
method_note: Daniel & Moskowitz (2016): after a bear market (past 12-month market return < 0, known at t-1; Daniel-Moskowitz use 24 months, too few bear months since 2016) momentum is short high-beta losers, so in a rebound its beta turns sharply negative: a negative bear x market coefficient is the crash mechanism. The momentum long-short series is built from the app's momentum scores (2016-10 on), so few bear months enter: read it as a diagnostic. Caveat: the universe is today's constituents (membership history starts 2026-10), so early years carry survivorship bias; read the premium as an upper bound.
expected_outputs: market beta in normal vs bear states (HAC)
